description:
Speedready is a reader for people learning German. It carries you through a book at a pace you set, so you keep reading instead of stopping at every unfamiliar word, and it puts the translation right where your eyes already are.

Above every word you have not marked as known sits its translation in Portuguese. Tap that translation and the word is marked as learned: it disappears from the whole book, and the page gets cleaner as your vocabulary grows.

WHILE YOU READ
• A highlight sweeps through the text at your pace, or words flash one at a time
• German nouns are colored by gender: blue for der, red for die, green for das
• Tap a word for its translation, to hear it, or to start reading from there
• Hold a word you are still learning: it is underlined everywhere and the pace slows for it
• Sentences are read aloud by your device's voice, with the text following along
• Bookmark a spot, jump between chapters, and pick up where you left off

YOUR OWN BOOKS
Open any EPUB or text file. Page numbers and headers left over from print are cleaned out, sentences broken by a page are joined again, and each book opens at chapter one.

IT STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
The dictionary and a public-domain German storybook are built in, so everything works offline. There is no account, no tracking and no ads. Everything you look up can be exported as an Anki deck.

The reader is free, open-source software. The dictionary uses Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0.
promotionalText: German nouns now show their gender in color: blue for der, red for die, green for das.
